parsed.notes: Covenants are under the 2022 Credit Facility as amended by the Sixth Amendment. The maximum Consolidated Total Leverage Ratio steps down to 5.25x (Q4 2026 and Q1 2027), then 5.00x (Q2 and Q3 2027), then 4.50x for each quarter thereafter. The company says it was in compliance at 9/30/2026. Intercompany credit agreement covenants with subsidiaries (Altor, Velocity, Arnold) are excluded because those loans eliminate in consolidation. The leverage-based pricing margin is also excluded.
